caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall boot placed upright against a plain, light beige background. The boot is brown, with varying shades giving it a worn and textured appearance. The boot has a rounded toe and a high shaft that reaches well above the ankle, extending upward in a slightly loose and wrinkled manner, exhibiting folds and creases along its length. The stitching around the sole and the upper part of the boot is visible, with detailed linework indicating areas of wear and construction. The overall composition centers the boot within the frame, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the drawing.
title: Boot
